question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A building containing interesting, rare, and old objects
solution:
The correct answer is **'Museum'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• **Museum:** A building where collections of valuable and interesting objects are kept and shown to the public. (संग्रहालय)

 
 
• **Example**: Museums and art galleries play an important role in our contemplation and understanding of life and death.
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that **museum** is the correct one-word substitute.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Auditorium:** The part of the theatre, the concert hall.(सभागार)
 
• **Stockroom: **A room where things are kept until they are needed.(गोदाम)
 
• **Mansion:** A very large house.(हवेली)
